comparison.objective: Turn three cartons on moving carriers so their labels face a fixed scanner.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed reorientation of moving objects without toppling or retaining contact.
comparison.success_condition: At each gate crossing, the carton must be upright, centered on its carrier, released, never table-touched, and label-aligned within 20 degrees.
comparison.reason: Tests moving-line interception and timed orientation, with no insertion, force-controlled fracture, or fragment collection.
